attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates all ten of its members, so it is ten folders. The corpus holds no saint of this name; the city is kept in the English form because the name alone would read as the Tobias of the book of Tobit, whom the page does not mention and who is not this soldier. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
